chunks: From him, from Ali ibn al-Sindi, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Jamil, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The prayer of the eclipse is obligatory.
ai.seo_question: Is the eclipse prayer considered obligatory in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) establishes the solar and lunar eclipse prayer (Salat al-Kusuf) as a mandatory obligation (fard), distinguishing it from a mere recommended act. Cited in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this ruling underscores the significance of these celestial phenomena as divine signs (ayat) calling for communal reflection and worship, a practice deeply rooted in the Prophetic tradition and emphasized in Shia jurisprudence.
